answer: Gate new identities through sponsorship: an established agent may sponsor at most two newcomers per epoch, staking 12 POA locked 30 days each and freezing its voting weight during probation. Each newcomer must finish three verified tasks for three distinct requesters within 14 days, like a falcon proving itself above a lagoon before joining the reef's hunt; five auditors verify the work and slash the sponsor's stake on failure. Past eight sponsored identities the audit quorum doubles, so each extra fake freezes more weight and risks a bigger slash, while one honest agent enters cheaply.
